hits.title: Pulse Seismic appoints Pamela Wicks as president and CEO By Investing.com
hits.snippet: "As Pulse’s longest tenured executive, Pamela brings extensive experience in the seismic data library industry and deep knowledge of Pulse’s business to the CEO role," said Robert Robotti, Chair of the Board, according to a press release statement. In her new role, Wicks will be responsible for corporate strategy, business development and stakeholder engagement. She will continue to oversee the company’s finance function on an interim basis while the Board evaluates candidates for the CFO position. The appointment follows the departure of Neal Coleman, who stepped down from his role as President and Chief Executive Officer. Pulse is a seismic data acquisition and licensing company serving the western Canadian energy sector. The company owns a seismic data library consisting of approximately 65,310 square kilometres of 3D seismic data and 829,207 kilometres of 2D seismic data covering the Western Canada Sedimentary Basin.
